The '''Industrial Pipe''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|300}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. 

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Most "decor" furniture items can be placed outside. However, the Industrial Pipe must be placed against an interior wall, rendering it useable indoors only.
